Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly identified the class associated with the ability "Metamorphosis". In World of Warcraft, "Metamorphosis" is the signature major ability of the **Warlock** class (specifically the Affliction spec), which allows them to channel damage spells rapidly. The Expert mistakenly attributed this ability to the **Demon Hunter**, which is incorrect (Demon Hunters have abilities like "Demonic Possession" or "Rend", but not Metamorphosis). This fundamental error in identifying the class based on a specific ability led to the exclusion of the Warlock and the inclusion of the Demon Hunter, resulting in the wrong final list. Additionally, the Expert failed to account for the armor type of the Warlock (Cloth) correctly in the context of the "two cloth wearers" clue while trying to fit the Demon Hunter (Leather) and Druid (Leather), creating a conflict with the "two plate, two cloth" constraint if the Warlock was replaced by a Demon Hunter.
